Sesame Ground Chicken

4 servings

For the chicken:

  • 1 lb ground chicken
  • 1 tablespoon sesame oil, divided
  • Salt and pepper, to taste

For the sauce:

  • 1/3 cup soy sauce
  • 2 tablespoons rice vinegar
  • 1 (14 oz) can coconut milk
  • Optional: sesame seeds
  1. Brown the chicken in sesame oil.
  2. Stir in the sauce.
  3. Serve over rice.

Use ground turkey if you prefer.
